entry.name: Excadrill Mega
entry.flavorEs: Se lo conoce como el Rey del Taladro. Puede horadar túneles bajo tierra a una velocidad de 150 km/h.
entry.flavorZh: 别名钻头王。在地底下 挖掘前进的速度 达到了每小时１５０公里。

abilities.textEn: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
abilities.textEs: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
abilities.detail: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando el Pokémon usa movimientos de contacto, puede golpear incluso a los objetivos que se están protegiendo, infligiendo 1/4 del daño que el movimiento causaría normalmente. Todo lo demás, aparte de los efectos protectores del objetivo, se activa con normalidad.
abilities.detailZh: 当此宝可梦使用接触类招式时，即使目标正在保护自己也能击中，造成该招式原本伤害的1/4。除目标的保护效果外，其他一切效果仍会正常触发。
abilities.detailPt: Quando o Pokémon usa movimentos de contato, ele pode atingir até mesmo alvos que estejam se protegendo, causando 1/4 do dano que o movimento causaria normalmente. Tudo, exceto os efeitos protetores do alvo, ainda é acionado.
